name: stats-bento
blurb: Bento grid layout with primary hero stat, growth chart, awards, and rating card.
description: Section component arranging stats in a Bento grid (6 cols × 2 rows). Primary stat (64%) spans 3×2 with diagonal pattern overlay. Secondary row shows growth (+240% with inline bar chart), award count (12), and G2 rating (4.9/5) as smaller cards. Static layout, hardcoded data.
use_when: Landing page hero sections with multiple KPIs or SaaS metrics.
avoid_when: Reusable stats component; data is hardcoded.
a11y: Semantic section element. Stat labels are descriptive text. Bar chart heights are CSS-driven but not accessible to screen readers (decorative).
